description: This file defines the AutolockService class responsible for managing automatic application locking based on user activity and focus, including polling for document visibility and handling auto-lock intervals.

classes.name: AutolockService
classes.description: A service class that manages automatic locking of the application based on focus and user inactivity, with configurable intervals.

methods.name: onAppLaunch
methods.description: Starts polling when the application launches.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up timers and event observers when the service is deinitialized.

methods.name: addAppEventObserverAfterSubclassesFinishConstructing
methods.description: Schedules adding an application event observer after construction completes.

methods.name: addAppEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an event observer to handle application launch events.

methods.name: lockApplication
methods.description: Locks the application if a passcode is set.

methods.name: setAutoLockInterval
methods.description: Sets the auto-lock interval value in storage.

methods.name: getAutoLockInterval
methods.description: Retrieves the auto-lock interval from storage, defaults to none.

methods.name: deleteAutolockPreference
methods.description: Removes auto-lock preference and cancels auto-lock timer.

methods.name: beginPolling
methods.description: Starts polling to check application lock status and document focus.

methods.name: documentVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in document visibility, starting or canceling auto-lock timer accordingly.

methods.name: beginAutoLockTimer
methods.description: Sets a timer to auto-lock the application after the configured interval.
